name: Metabase MCP
description: Connects Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients to your Metabase so analysts can search dashboards, query data with SQL or Metabase's query language, and chart results.

skills.name: Content Search
skills.description: Searches and browses Metabase collections, questions, dashboards, models and metrics, scoped to the connecting user's permissions.

skills.name: Execute Query
skills.description: Runs queries in Metabase's query language for counts, sums, grouping, filters and joins against connected databases.

skills.name: Execute SQL
skills.description: Writes and runs raw SQL on connected databases for window functions, CTEs and engine-specific functions.

skills.name: Visualize Query
skills.description: Renders a query result as an inline bar, line or table chart that clients such as Claude can display and drill into.

skills.name: Content Write
skills.description: Creates and edits Metabase questions, dashboards and documents, and sets up scheduled alerts to email or Slack.
